preconditions.description: The input must be a list containing exactly two strings.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Both elements in the list must be strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '\n'.join(f'{a} {b}' for a, b in itertools.zip_longest(strings[0], strings[1], fillvalue=' '))
postconditions.description: The output must be a string where each line contains corresponding characters from the two input strings separated by a space, with spaces filling in for missing characters in the shorter string.
